title: twelfth AI visibility checker
description: Free, no sign-in: grade how well a product page reads to AI shopping agents like ChatGPT.

tools.name: check_product_page
tools.description: Check how well one public product page reads to AI shopping agents (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). Use it when someone asks whether their product pages are ready for AI shopping or agentic commerce, why an assistant gets a product's price or stock wrong, or to audit Product structured data before a launch. It fetches the page once and grades its schema.org Product markup against the published Google merchant listing and OpenAI product feed specs, returning a 0 to 100 score, each check with what is missing and why it matters, unscored signals on whether AI crawlers can reach and read the page, the facts the markup states, and a shareable result link. A store that refuses automated requests is reported as blocked, never scored; a category or search page is refused. Server HTML only (markup added by JavaScript is not seen); each URL is cached for 24 hours; 10 checks an hour per address and 30 per store domain. For a retailer's own sales, stock and pricing, use twelfth's workspace MCP (https://api.twelfth.ai/mcp) instead.

url.description: The full public address of one product page, such as https://shop.example.com/products/blue-kettle. http or https on the standard ports only; private and internal addresses are refused.
